::: {.lead}
I'm Dr Will Hardy, a Research Fellow in Pharmacoeconomics at the Centre for
Health Economics and Medicines Evaluation (CHEME), Bangor University. I work on
the economic evaluation of health technologies, mostly alongside clinical
trials, and on the methods that health technology assessment relies on.
:::
